title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew ☕ — Saturday, September 12, 2026

🌤️ Weather
Warm and muggy today: high near 81°F, low around 72°F. Partly cloudy by day, but thunderstorms likely late tonight with a 90% chance of rain (locally heavy). What to bring: light layers plus an umbrella if you'll be out late.

🗞️ Headlines
• Trump is in Dublin this weekend, meeting Ireland's president and PM around a major golf tournament.
• Fallout from the Charlie Kirk assassination continues, spilling into a wave of online doxing.
• An Amazon cargo plane overshot a Miami runway, crashing into vehicles and catching fire — reviving safety questions about its contract carriers.
• Xi and Modi met on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit, with Beijing urging "proper" handling of differences.
• Putin slammed Western "ugly" trade tactics at the BRICS Business Forum, citing 30,000+ sanctions on Russia.

🚇 Getting around
Busy weekend for transit. LIRR is suspended between Atlantic Terminal and Jamaica all weekend (free subway transfers at several Manhattan/Brooklyn stops). Several subway segments are out too — check the MTA Weekender before you head out.

🎉 NYC today
It's NY Fashion Week — runway shows all day at Edison Ballroom in Times Square. Elsewhere: Marcus King Band plays SummerStage at 7, and Bryant Park has free family activities (Limón dance, juggling, the carousel) from mid-morning.

💡 Nugget
Late-night storms tonight, so if you're catching a Fashion Week show or SummerStage, aim for the earlier sets and you'll likely beat the rain home.
